basics.name: Ivan Gegov
basics.label: AI systems builder, orchestration and infrastructure
basics.summary: AI systems builder who designs, ships, and operates agentic software, orchestration and control planes, source-grounded research pipelines, retrieval and long-term memory, provider-aware model workflows, voice interfaces, and full-stack public products. Work spans editorial AI publishing, evidence-graded knowledge bases, a paper-only multi-agent finance desk, repository intelligence, typed decision systems, local-model tooling, and interactive web — with delivery across Windows, VPS/Oracle, GCP, Vercel, Supabase, n8n, and private model infrastructure.

work.name: Independent
work.summary: Self-directed engineering and operations across AI products, agent orchestration, research systems, retrieval, automation, voice, and delivery infrastructure.
highlights: Built and operated multi-agent development/orchestration systems with typed contracts, task routing, evidence receipts, review gates, provider-aware fallback, and explicit unknown/abstain states.
Built source-backed memory and retrieval systems with append-only raw-event capture, SQLite/FTS5 lexical search, vector retrieval, embeddings, citations, and provenance attached to source events.

Built multi-corpus research ingestion pipelines that turn papers and documents into chunks, extracted claims, evidence tiers, provenance triples, embeddings, and cited knowledge bases across parenting, ADHD, strength science, and women's health.
Used Anthropic Message Batches and OpenAI-compatible providers for batch extraction while retaining JSONL evidence and refusing to turn missing sources into confident answers.
Built evidence-first GitHub PR operations with independent gather/decide/review/act stages, GitHub API/SSE/MCP integration, model routing, honest CI evidence, and escalate-don't-guess behavior.
Built provider-neutral routing and local-model tooling: typed OpenAI-compatible decisions, model refusal/unknown outcomes, Ollama/local GGUF serving, and a hardware-aware no-cloud launcher.
Delivered public AI products including The Drop, MoneyWolf, Steady Steps, GymScholar, Open Dashboard, the public Council, OpenRouter GitHub Dashboard, and the wider SD Forest / Forest HUB.
Built voice and multimodal experiments with OpenAI Realtime, Gemini Live, ElevenLabs, Google TTS, Pocket TTS, Hume Octave 2, MCP, messaging surfaces, and car-mode constraints.
Operated delivery across Windows/PowerShell, Vercel, Oracle/VPS, KVM2, Docker/Compose, Caddy, systemd, GCP Secret Manager, n8n, GitHub Actions, Tailscale, and Windows Task Scheduler.
